properties.documentation:
Independent trans-gorge autonomous sailing challenge.
Inspired by the structure of the Microtransat rules:
https://microtransat.org/content.php?p=rules&top=rules
This is a separate project challenge, not a Microtransat entry or endorsement.
Vessel architecture and communications technology are unrestricted; overall length is limited to 1.2 m.
The Gorge is the proving ground for a longer-term voyage toward Hawaii.
Marker-referenced virtual gates are defined in BlueDog::Mission::Course.
There is no completion deadline. The vehicle defines candidate environmental qualification profiles; no dam passage is permitted.
properties.name: Challenge
TransGorgeChallenge
properties.documentation: The vessel shall autonomously sail one round trip from Bingen, around buoy 16 near Stevenson, and back to Bingen.

properties.name: CourseCompletion
properties.documentation: The vessel shall cross the Bingen departure gate, the buoy 16 rounding checkpoints and the Bingen finish gate in that order during one attempt.
After its first circuit, the vessel should repeat Bingen–Stevenson–Bingen autonomously for as long as practical.
properties.name: RepeatedOperation

properties.documentation: A qualifying attempt shall complete the round trip without operator intervention.
properties.name: UnassistedAttempt
SailingPropulsion
properties.documentation: A qualifying attempt shall use sailing propulsion without auxiliary motor propulsion.

properties.name: LiveObservation
properties.documentation: The vessel shall deliver position, operating mode and health updates at intervals no greater than 30 seconds while the monitoring link is available.

properties.name: EmergencyIntervention
properties.documentation: The vessel shall permit remote emergency abort or manual control when a command link is available.

properties.name: NavigationRules
properties.documentation: The vessel shall comply with the U.S. Inland Navigation Rules (33 CFR parts 83 through 90) and applicable local navigation provisions throughout the attempt on the approved Gorge course.

properties.name: RestrictedWaters
properties.documentation: The vessel shall remain outside waters prohibited to the attempt configuration.
The vessel shall complete the course without collision with other waterway users.
properties.name: TrafficCoexistence

properties.documentation: The vessel overall length shall not exceed 1.2 m.
properties.name: OverallLength
SafetyCapabilityAbort
properties.documentation: The vessel shall autonomously terminate qualification when a required safety capability is lost.

properties.name: AutonomousShoreRecovery
properties.documentation: Following a safety abort, the vessel shall autonomously initiate recovery toward a suitable shore-accessible retrieval location.
The vessel shall attempt immediate transmission of an abort alert when an abort is declared.
properties.name: AbortAlert

properties.documentation: The vessel shall support recovery without abandonment of the vessel or its major components in the waterway.
properties.name: NoLittering
CasualtyFlotation
properties.documentation: The vessel shall remain afloat following capsize or hull flooding.
The vessel shall retain its rig, ballast and battery following capsize or hull flooding.
properties.name: MajorComponentRetention
CapsizeRecovery
properties.documentation: The vessel shall demonstrate autonomous travel to a suitable shore retrieval location following capsize without communications.

properties.name: UnattachedPassage
properties.documentation: A qualifying attempt shall remain afloat and unattached throughout the scored passage.

properties.name: OutageAutonomy
properties.documentation: Loss of communications alone shall not terminate an otherwise safe qualifying attempt.

properties.name: ForecastAdmission
properties.documentation: Launch authorization shall require a forecast window assessed to support the complete round trip with waiting and recovery margins.

properties.name: WeatherOutageContinuation
properties.documentation: The vessel shall permit continued qualification during weather-service outage only while the last forecast remains applicable and required safety capabilities remain available.

properties.name: CourseRecoveryReserve
properties.documentation: The vessel shall protect sufficient energy to reach a suitable shore retrieval location from its current course position.

properties.name: ReserveAbort
properties.documentation: The vessel shall initiate autonomous recovery before further mission continuation would compromise the course-dependent recovery reserve.
The vessel shall support qualifying operation in darkness.
properties.name: NightOperation

properties.documentation: An aborted attempt shall remain disqualified until a new attempt begins at the departure gate.
properties.name: AbortPersistence

properties.documentation: The vessel shall present conspicuous recovery indications during autonomous shore recovery.
properties.name: RecoveryConspicuity
NavigationRuleApplicability
properties.documentation: Before entry approval, the entrant shall submit a configuration-specific navigation-rule applicability assessment.
The organizer shall record and maintain the reviewed rule and notice baseline for the attempt.
properties.name: NavigationRuleBaseline

properties.documentation: The organizer shall approve entry only when the configuration-specific navigation evidence satisfies the entry-evidence conditions.
properties.name: NavigationEntryEvidence
OperatorSafetyIntervention
properties.documentation: The operator shall intervene when necessary if autonomous safety action is insufficient and intervention is available.

properties.name: NavigationAdjudication
properties.documentation: The organizer shall record the attempt qualification decision and its supporting reason against the navigation adjudication conditions.
